import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut


def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    """Select events with >=2 muons above pt_threshold and an opposite-charge leading pair."""
    muons = events.Muon[events.Muon.pt > params["pt_threshold"]]
    muons = muons[ak.argsort(muons.pt, axis=1, ascending=False)]
    padded = ak.pad_none(muons, 2, axis=1)

    mask = (ak.num(muons, axis=1) >= 2) & (padded.charge[:, 0] != padded.charge[:, 1])

    return ak.where(ak.is_none(mask), False, mask)


dimuon = Cut(
    name="dimuon",
    params={"pt_threshold": 15},
